SK19 is the Slovak national under-19 championship of the professional clubs' youth sides, not a senior league. No season or competition article exists ('1. liga dorastu', 'Dorastenecká liga', 'Slovak U19 League' all missing on sk/en Wikipedia) and no published season window was found. The quoted line is the SLO1 window the asset's 07-25 start and end were inherited from, not this competition's own window. No proxy used.
